text:
ellie (AE): FYI — ran a follow-up for Avalon this AM. Cold baseline (cache off) peaked at ~1.85k sustained QPS with p99 ~440ms on their mixed workload. They want Dedicated sizing and committed estimate for 2.5k sustained + 20% burst.
joe (SE): can you paste the mix? need proportions chat/short-gen/embeds and avg token lengths.
ellie (AE): mix: 55% chat (~210 tokens), 35% short-gen (64 tokens), 10% embeddings. sample file = avalon-sample-v2.json (scarbed copy).
tim (SRE): noted. i reproduced on staging: cold run matches ~1.8k p99 420-460ms. then ran a 20m warm-up (steady at 2.0k) + 10m at target 2.5k. warmed steady showed p99 drop to ~260-300ms and sustained throughput 2.4k before queuing.
sara (Solutions): that's promising — include both CSVs. can we also show quantization delta (fp16 vs q4f16) and a tiny KV-cache effectiveness test? Avalon asked how much they'd save if they accept q4f16.
matt (Infra): ran fp16 vs q4f16 back-to-back on same cluster. results (summary):
- fp16: sustain 2.4k, p50 45ms, p95 160ms, p99 260ms
- q4f16: sustain 2.4k, p50 48ms, p95 180ms, p99 300ms
CPU/GPU utilization + memory within expected. q4f16 ~12% lower cost per token in infra hours. csvs uploaded to /artifacts/avalon/5099999999/{fp16,q4}.csv (will DM links).
sam (Security): security checklist for POC: KMS endpoint + IAM role for CMK, token redaction enabled, logs to their VPC or customer-supplied S3? Also SOC2 note — POC uses scrubbed prompts only. need Avalon confirmation for data residency.
avalon-pm: @ellie we can provide KMS endpoint and want logs in our VPC for the POC. Also curious about warm strategy — what triggers cache warm?
joe (SE): cache warm = repeated prefixes + short steady traffic. i recommend a 15m warm at 70% of target with repeated user prefixes for KV. we did a micro-cache run: 5m, 10% repeated prefixes -> p99 improved from 300ms -> 220ms on warmed clusters. shows ~8-12% tail improvement depending on pattern.
ellie (AE): perfect. procurement asked for committed pricing for 2.5k sustained with 20% burst and 99.9% SLA. can solutions ops draft monthly $ estimate? include fp16 vs q4f16 options.
sara (Solutions): drafting. ballpark (w/ reserved nodes + discount): fp16 committed estimate = $XX,XXX/mo; q4f16 committed estimate = ~12% lower. i'll produce a small table and include per-token effective cost and amortized infra hours.
perf-bot: perf job finished: perf-runner/2026-04-02T11:03Z (run id 5099999999)
tim (SRE): attaching perf logs later today. note: tail behavior increases with peak bursts; recommend provisioning headroom ~20-25% above sustained for 99.9% SLA.
joe (SE): also include a short runbook for Dedicated handover: - cluster size, model variant, autoscale thresholds, fallback model for overload, cache settings. i'll draft.
ellie (AE): thanks team. checklist for final deliverable to Avalon: 1) cold-run CSV + heatmap, 2) warmed-run CSV + heatmap, 3) fp16 vs q4f16 comparison CSVs + cost delta, 4) KV cache micro-run and delta, 5) security note (KMS/logs/PII), 6) monthly committed pricing table + notes, 7) ops runbook for Dedicated handoff.
sam (Security): i'll send the short security blurb to Avalon PM and cc infra.
matt (Infra): linking CSVs and a short script to reproduce the load:
```bash
# cold baseline
loadtest --target 1850 --duration 10m --pattern poisson --payload avalon-sample-v2.json --cache-disabled
# warm then steady
loadtest --target 2000 --duration 20m --pattern poisson --payload avalon-sample-v2.json --cache-enabled --repeat-prefix-rate 15
loadtest --target 2500 --duration 10m --pattern poisson --payload avalon-sample-v2.json --cache-enabled --concurrency 700
```
john (ellie): sharing with Avalon PM now. joe will assemble final packet for procurement. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
